priorityList: Summon your pet before combat starts.
Use Algethar's Puzzle Box pre-combat and whenever Bestial Wrath is nearly ready (within 2 seconds).
Use offensive racials (Berserking, Blood Fury, or Ancestral Call) and combat potions when Bestial Wrath is ready.
Sync use-effect trinkets (such as Light Company Guidon or Void Execution Mandate) with Bestial Wrath usage.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath has less than 1.5 seconds remaining on cooldown to prepare Frenzy stacks.
Cast Kill Command as your highest priority attack, especially when Nature's Ally or Howl buffs are active.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pet or to prevent the ability from reaching 2 full charges.
Cast Cobra Shot during Bestial Wrath to reset the cooldown of Kill Command if the Killer Cobra talent is active.
Use any remaining on-use trinkets (such as Ranger Captain's Iridescent Insignia or Void Stalker's Contract) on cooldown.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when Kill Command is on cooldown and you have excess Focus.
